review.verdict: Usable visual concept with minor feedback/readability issues; sampled final gameplay state matches the plan.
review.method: Inspected ffmpeg-extracted frames against the combined first-frame image and source-checked plan; no continuous playback or listening.
review.first_frame_layout: Preserves the 6×6 grid, color regions, HUD/rule strip and lower decorations. Complete portrait composition remains visible.
review.gameplay_state: One dog appears in the correct top-row second-column yellow cell around 4.5–5s. Counter becomes 1/6 and remains there through 11s; all 3 bones remain. No extra dogs or persistent exclusion marks are visible; no completion panel.
review.input_clarity: Hand stays on the correct yellow cell with expanding touch pulses around 2.5–3.5s. These sampled frames do not establish two discrete contacts within the original double-tap window.
review.vfx_readability: The paw halo at 5s is much larger than one cell and washes over adjacent tiles; it clears by 8s. The dog pop briefly rises above its tile at 4.5s. The accepted destination remains identifiable.
review.ui_continuity: Grid geometry, colors and rule text remain readable and stable at the settled samples. The 1/6 digits briefly smear/ghost during the 5s counter pulse, then become clear; no new controls appear.

audio.note: AAC presence verified only; voiceover, sound design and synchronization were not listened to.

review.technical_note: Actual video stream is 1078×1920 rather than exact 1080×1920; container duration 12.064s.
recommended_adjustments: Keep the paw halo closer to the accepted cell and reduce warm spill onto neighboring colors.
Keep counter glyphs sharp during the update and show two clearly separated quick tap contacts.
review.limitations: Visual sampling supports the observed concept outcome, not executable gameplay correctness.
